profile.delete.lead: Removes your account and everything in it, for good.
profile.delete.what: This deletes your e-mail, your names, points, badges and all your missions. It cannot be undone.
profile.delete.last_admin: You are the only admin. Make a colleague an admin before you delete yourself.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Nisse Missions stores as little as possible. This says what, why and for how long.
privacy.stored.title: What we store
privacy.stored.body: Your e-mail address, used only to sign in and kept in the sign-in service. The nisse or farm name you choose, the story you play, and your game rows: missions, points and badges. Nothing else.
privacy.seen.title: What colleagues see
privacy.seen.body: Your name, your score and your badges. Never your e-mail, and not which missions you were given or skipped.
privacy.admin.title: What the admin sees
privacy.admin.body: Group totals, such as how many were active this week, plus the same leaderboard as everyone else. No view of what an individual has done. The admin can adjust points, and that is logged.
privacy.retention.title: For how long
privacy.retention.body: Game data is deleted 90 days after a season ends. The log of admin changes is deleted after 400 days, and the operations log after 60 days.
privacy.delete.title: Delete yourself
privacy.delete.body: Under Me you will find «Delete me». It removes your account and everything in it at once, and it cannot be undone.
privacy.tracking.title: Tracking
privacy.tracking.body: No analytics, no trackers, no third-party cookies and no external fonts or scripts. The app only remembers your theme, language and sign-in in your own browser.
privacy.contact.title: Questions
privacy.contact.body: Ask the admin of your group. Report a security problem privately through GitHub (Security, Report a vulnerability) in the source code.
profile.delete.done: Your account is deleted. Thanks for playing!

privacy.push.title: Notifications (experimental)
privacy.push.body: If you turn notifications on, we store the address and keys your browser gives us for sending them, together with your language, which of the two notifications you want and which site a tap should open. Nothing else about the device. The address is deleted when you turn notifications off, sign out on the device, delete your account, or when the browser says it is no longer valid.
pwa.guide.title: Bring the nisse home
pwa.guide.lead: Put Nisseoppdrag on your Home Screen. It then opens like an app, and the nisse can tell you when new missions are in the sack.
pwa.guide.open: Install the app and turn on notifications
pwa.step.share.title: Tap the Share button
pwa.step.share.body: The square with the arrow pointing up, at the bottom of the screen. On iPad it is at the top right.
pwa.step.more.title: Tap ⋯, then Share
pwa.step.more.body: The three dots at the bottom right by the address field. In the menu that opens, tap Share.
pwa.step.ios_other.title: Find the Share button
pwa.step.ios_other.body: In Chrome it is in the address bar at the top, in Firefox and Edge in the menu. If you cannot find it, open the page in Safari instead.
pwa.step.add.title: Choose “Add to Home Screen”
pwa.step.add.body: Scroll down the list a little if you do not see it right away.
pwa.step.confirm.title: Tap “Add”
pwa.step.confirm.body: At the top right. You can keep the name as it is.
pwa.step.confirm.body_26: Leave “Open as Web App” on and tap “Add” at the top right.
pwa.step.open.title: Open Nisseoppdrag from your Home Screen
pwa.step.open.body: Look for the nisse cap with the two eyes. Sign in there, and the nisse will ask about notifications.
pwa.step.notify.title: Turn on notifications in the app
pwa.step.notify.body: Your phone only sends notifications to apps on the Home Screen. Tap “Turn on notifications” when the app asks, and choose Allow.
pwa.step.old_ios.title: Notifications need a newer iOS
pwa.step.old_ios.body: Notifications work from iOS 16.4. You can still use the app, and notifications arrive once the phone is updated.
pwa.step.inapp.title: Open the page in Safari first
pwa.step.inapp.body: You are in the browser inside another app, which cannot add things to the Home Screen. Tap ⋯ or the compass and choose “Open in Safari”, or copy the link and paste it into Safari.
pwa.step.prompt.title: Install with one tap
pwa.step.prompt.body: Your browser can install Nisseoppdrag as an app, with its own icon and notifications.
pwa.step.android_menu.title: Open the ⋮ menu
pwa.step.android_menu.body: The three dots at the top right in Chrome. In Samsung Internet the ☰ menu is at the bottom.
pwa.step.android_install.title: Choose “Install app”
pwa.step.android_install.body: Some phones call it “Add to Home screen”. Confirm with Install.
pwa.step.desktop.title: Install from the address bar
pwa.step.desktop.body: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar (a screen with an arrow), or open the ⋮ menu and choose “Install Nisseoppdrag”.
pwa.step.mac.title: Choose File › Add to Dock
pwa.step.mac.body: In Safari on a Mac you add Nisseoppdrag to the Dock from the File menu. It then gets its own window and notifications.
pwa.step.desktop_notify.title: Turn on notifications
pwa.step.desktop_notify.body: Notifications work both in the app and in the browser.
pwa.step.firefox.title: Notifications right in the tab
pwa.step.firefox.body: Firefox does not install web apps, but notifications still work while the browser is open.
pwa.step.installed.title: The nisse has moved in
pwa.step.installed.body: The app is installed. Only the notifications are missing.
pwa.push.title: Notifications
pwa.push.lead: Two small nudges a week, no more: Monday when the missions are ready, and Thursday if some are left.
pwa.push.enabled: Notifications are on. The nisse will let you know!
pwa.push.on: Notifications are on for this device.
pwa.push.reminder: Thursday: a reminder if some are left
pwa.push.test_sent: The nisse sent a notification. It will arrive in a moment.
pwa.push.test_held: Wait a little before trying again.
pwa.push.denied: Notifications are blocked for Nisseoppdrag. You can allow them again in your browser or app settings.
pwa.push.needs_install: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work from the app on the Home Screen.
pwa.push.unsupported: This browser cannot receive notifications. On iPhone you need iOS 16.4 or later.
pwa.push.signin: Sign in first, then you can turn on notifications.
pwa.push.error: Notifications could not be turned on right now. Please try again later.
pwa.push.privacy: We only store the address your browser gives us for notifications, and delete it when you turn them off or delete your account.
